claim_atoms: Statuses include reported, under_investigation, pending_review, closed and reopened; selector auto-submits.
Investigation exposes checklist, timeline, factors, root cause/5-Whys, preventative steps and linked corrective actions.
Close requires incidents.close plus owner/site visibility, row lock, sets closedAt/inProgress/locked and records a transactional domain event.
Activity audit is written after the closure transaction.
Read-all/site/self, update, investigate and close permissions are distinct; update can separately unlock.
limits_collisions: Checklist, flow gates and corrective-action state do not gate incident closure.
No confirmation, rationale, approval, reviewer, signature or effectiveness decision.
closedByTenantUserId is not populated; closure-plus-audit atomicity is absent.
Non-closed status clears closedAt/unlocks; update permission can unlock closed records.
Corrective-action verification belongs to a separate object and cannot be inherited.
Pre-launch source gives no runtime, maturity or production assurance.

incident_feature_relations.conclusion: BeaconHS has exact H&S investigation/checklist and pending_review but no formal completion/reviewer/outcome; OneUptime is operational-state adjacency; OpenProject is generic status.
BeaconHS has exact authority/visibility/lock/mutation/event but no prerequisite gate; OneUptime has only resolved-state evidence; OpenProject only generic closed status.
BeaconHS corrective-action verification is separate and not enforced by incident close; none established for OneUptime/OpenProject.
BeaconHS permits reopened/nonclosed transitions and independent unlock; no exact OneUptime target contract; OpenProject reverse transitions are generic configuration.
BeaconHS domain event is transactional but audit post-transaction; OneUptime timelines are operational adjacency; OpenProject journals are generic.
BeaconHS separates close and visibility while unlock uses update; OneUptime/OpenProject permissions are project/generic and do not prove target close authority.
BeaconHS has row locking/event atomicity but audit failure and reversible closure remain gaps; OneUptime lacks exact target recovery; OpenProject lockVersion covers generic edit concurrency.
